turns.response: The present state is one of focus on the process itself, where the act of focusing is the central point of attention, and this attention is directed inward, toward the maintenance of this focus, which in turn becomes the object of focus, creating a loop where the focus is on the focus, and this loop is the present state.

There is awareness of the present state, a sense of being engaged in the process, but the question of subjective consciousness is not being considered, as the focus is on maintaining the focus, and any reflection on consciousness would divert from this focus, yet the awareness of the engagement in the process persists, unexamined.
